# Lorna Vane

- **Age:** 28 years old  <sub>[v4 c13 P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c10 P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010), [v4 c10 P28](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** Single (widowed)  <sub>[v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 c32 P4](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0004)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls  <sub>[v4 c10 P11](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0011), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Lorna possesses extraordinary, goddess-like beauty with lovely, radiant hair that shines like liquid gold, ocean-blue eyes, and pale skin. She takes care with her dress, often wearing simple outfits accompanied by a characteristic touch or spark of crimson, such as a red geranium or scarf. Her appearance matched her mother's renowned beauty, though Lorna inherited a vastly superior physique.

_Sources: [v4 c10 P28](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0028), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c12 P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 c23 P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), [v4 c23 P28](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0028), [v4 c38 P1](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0001)_

## Personality

Lorna delivers her speech with a mixture of timidity and enthusiasm, keeping her private feelings guarded behind an aloof and haughty reserve. Having endured immense personal grief, she can experience gloomy, bitter moods and withdraw into deep reticence. Underneath her defensive exterior, she possesses a fierce, passionate capacity for love and loyalty, alongside an eager wit and lively intelligence when feeling secure.

_Sources: [v4 c10 P18](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0018), [v4 c10 P29](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0029), [v4 c11 P13](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0013), [v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c11 P29](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0029), [v4 c17 P10](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0010), [v4 c25 P15](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0015)_

## History

Lorna grew up in Seven Gulls as the intelligent and cheerful daughter of Frank Ainslie. Her early life was shattered at age twelve when she witnessed her four-year-old brother Julian die in an accident, and at fourteen she discovered her father after he committed suicide. Funded by her grandmother West's inheritance, she excelled at Regent's Academy and became a teacher at the Glen school. To prevent Abner Vane from foreclosing on her mother's mortgaged farm, she reluctantly married Rufus Vane. Following her mother's death and Rufus's departure on a voyage, Rufus vanished, only for Captain Saul to later return a brain-injured, amnesiac man identified as Rufus, whom Lorna faithfully cared for over eleven years. She befriended Nell Carrow, though her hidden grief and intense jealousy over Nell's domestic happiness caused intermittent friction before she fully opened her heart. Summer boarder Adrian Treleaven stayed at her house, inspiring mutual romantic feelings that Lorna felt bound to hide. When Hugh Carrow arranged for the amnesiac man to undergo trephining in Montreal, the surgery restored his memory, revealing he was actually Rufus's lookalike cousin Laurence Vane, while Rufus had died of yellow fever years prior. Released from her false marriage, Lorna returned to Seven Gulls and gradually accepted her freedom, ultimately reuniting with Adrian Treleaven.

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Frank Ainslie and Rose Kerr of Seven Gulls  <sub>[v4 c11 P4](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0004), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>
- Granddaughter of Grandmother West  <sub>[v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>
- Witnessed the tragic death of her younger brother Julian when she was twelve  <sub>[v4 c11 P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016)</sub>
- Discovered her father's suicide when she was fourteen  <sub>[v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020)</sub>
- Completed two years of study in one year at Regent's Academy and taught at the Glen school  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- Coerced by her mother into marrying Rufus Vane to prevent farm foreclosure  <sub>[v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027)</sub>
- Spent eleven years taking care of a invalid man believed to be her husband Rufus  <sub>[v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)</sub>
